text:
Ana (Growth): Quick sync — finalizing the runbook for landing copy across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. We need one cohesive launch post + webinar hook + inbound routing plan. Draft here: https://tiny.redwood/landing-playbook-v1 :spiral_calendar:
Matt (Content): Reading. Can we keep hero headlines short and mode-specific lines under the fold? Example: "Hosted API: Start fast. Scale later."
Sophia (Product Marketing): That feels good. For Dedicated use: "Predictable capacity, enterprise SLAs." For Private: "Deploy in your VPC, meet compliance." Keep the value ladder consistent so the pages map to one inbound flow.
Ryan (Sales Ops): Important: inbound leads need mode signal. If someone clicks "Book demo" on Dedicated, route to AE queue A; Hosted -> self-serve nurture; Private -> security screening form + AE. Can we add a hidden utm param per CTA?
Liam (Design): I'll make CTA variants: primary (Start free), secondary (Book demo), tertiary (Request private eval). Will drop mockups by 5pm.
Matt (Content): Copy variants for the hero CTA text: 1) Start free (hosted) 2) Reserve capacity (dedicated) 3) Request private eval (private). Also microcopy under hero: quick bullets for latency, cost predictability, and compliance.
Sophia (Product Marketing): We should surface a short benchmark stat on each page: Hosted = median 40ms p50 for 2k token workload, Dedicated = sustained 100k tokens/min, Private = SOC2 + FedRAMP in progress. Use language: "Verified performance profiles" not raw numbers on the public page for Private.
Ana (Growth): Agree on benchmarks but keep public phrasing modest. We'll use a gated benchmark kit in the webinar/asset for prospects who register. That lets us capture lead intent.
Ryan (Sales Ops): Webinar routing: registrants who select "Interested in Dedicated/Private" get AE follow-up within 24h, add to CS Outreach playbook. Add form field: "Primary use case" + "Estimated monthly tokens" (buckets).
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar landing will auto-create HubSpot campaign when form is published. Set pipeline id = marketing-webinar-2026-03.
Matt (Content): For the launch post copy — iteration plan: short opener (what problem), 3 mode bullets, 2 benchmark highlights, CTA to webinar + gated benchmark kit. Tone: pragmatic, developer-first.
Liam (Design): One more ask — keep hero assets neutral (no vendor logos) and show an animated token-latency graph for Hosted vs Dedicated (abstract). I'll prototype.
Sophia (Product Marketing): A/B plan: A) hero headline focused on speed, B) focused on cost predictability. Run for 2 weeks, metric = demo clicks / webinar signups.
Ana (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze = tomorrow 11am PT, design comps by 5pm, web QA Wednesday, soft launch Friday. I'll compile the final copy deck and update the doc.
Matt (Content): I'll push the three final hero + subhead variants into the doc now.
Ryan (Sales Ops): I'll map AE queues and set the routing matrix after you freeze copy.
Ana (Growth): Great — last call for objections. If none, I'll consolidate and post the final runbook and task checklist here by EOD. :thumbsup:
